data.exact_reserve_text: During 2018, in line with the terms of the 2016 YoA QS contract with 1856, the Syndicate ceded 15.4% of its whole account technical reserves, on the 2015 and prior years of account. The accounting treatment for this transaction, whilst having nil impact on the loss for the year has caused the Retained combined ratio to increase from 108.0% to 110.6%. The 2016 year of account has Reinsured to Close ("RITC") into the Syndicate's 2017 year of account for an RITC premium of GBP 217.8m. Under Lloyd's Accounting rules, the Syndicate's 2016 year of account closed at the end of 2018, with a return equal to (3.4%) of capacity.

prior_year_events.impact_description: The Syndicate had material exposure to Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria in the 2017 Year of Account; exposure to Hurricanes Irma and Maria deteriorated while there was an improvement for Hurricane Harvey, increasing uncertainty in an adverse direction for insurance liabilities.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2018 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 748.9m (2017 closing). During 2018 the syndicate ceded 15.4% of whole account technical reserves relating to 2015 and prior years under a YoA quota share with Syndicate 1856; additionally the 2016 year was Reinsured to Close into 2017 (RITC premium GBP 217.8m). The report does not quantify a single gross priorperiod movement figure; reserves were affected by material catastrophe and large losses (notably 2017 Hurricanes Harvey/Irma/Maria and 2018 events including Hurricane Michael, Typhoon Jebi, the Camp and Woolsey Wildfires and the Lurssen Shipyard loss), and by reinsurance/SPA transactions which alter retained reserves. No explicit gross prioryear reserve movement amount is stated in the notes.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year reserve movement amount is stated in the notes. A gross claims development triangle is present but is distorted by a Reinsurance-to-Close (RITC) transaction (2016 RITC into 2017) and SPA cessions that materially affect gross and retained balances; therefore the triangle was not used to compute a consolidated prior-year movement. Gross premium mix was taken from the Segmental Analysis (Note 2). Prior-year movement is reported in narrative only as cessions/RITC without a gross GBP m figure, so prior_year_development_gbp_m is null.
